name: Adrian Calderon
headline: Mechanical Engineering Student
credential: B.S. Mechanical Engineering · Florida International University · Expected May 2029
intro: Mechanical engineering student at Florida International University with a true passion for engineering.

bio: I'm a mechanical engineering student at Florida International University. I like the whole loop of a project: design the part, check it with analysis, build it, and fix whatever the first version gets wrong.

This past summer I was a Product Development intern in Vehicle Engineering at Ford in Dearborn, where I worked on cold-weather validation testing, track testing and test data tools. At FIU I'm a vehicle dynamics engineer on Panther Motorsports, our Formula SAE team, and I run professional development for SHPE FIU.
I work mostly in SolidWorks, Siemens NX and Ansys Mechanical, and I build with 3D printing, Arduino and Python. I'm bilingual in English and Spanish.
